title: Claude Fable May Have Just Disproved a 100-Year-Old Math Problem
description:
Claude Fable may have just disproved the Jacobian Conjecture, a problem thats stumped mathematicians for almost 100 years 🔥 A researcher named Levent ran the model and it found a counterexample, three separate inputs giving the same output while the Jacobian stays constant. Three independent checks found no errrors.
